name: Ignazio Cassis
bio: Ignazio Cassis is a Swiss physician and politician from the canton of Ticino, a member of FDP.The Liberals. A former Cantonal Doctor of Ticino and vice-president of the Swiss Medical Association (FMH), he sat in the National Council from 2007 to 2017. Elected to the Federal Council on 20 September 2017, he has headed the Federal Department of Foreign Affairs (FDFA/DFAE) since 1 November 2017 and served as President of the Swiss Confederation in 2022.
